reference.document: Intel SDM 325462-090, ERETU; Vol. 1 section 3.4.1.1; Vol. 3A section 8.4.2

implementation.entry: The V9 entry remains 64-bit CPL0 with FRED enabled, CET and RTM disabled, outside VMX non-root execution, ordinary successful frame/descriptor RAM and no asynchronous delivery.
implementation.standard_return: STAR-based compatibility selectors install flat CS/SS caches without descriptor reads, including selector wraparound.
implementation.descriptor_return: GDT/LDT CS.L=0 returns permit either CS.D value; the truncated RIP must fit the effective segment limit. L=1/D=1 and nonstandard null CS/SS selectors reject before any state or RAM write. Existing ordered accessed-bit handling is reused.
implementation.defined_state: ERETU clears RIP/RSP bits 63:32 even for CS.D=0. It explicitly loads all 64 RSP bits; slot 4 is therefore unused. All earlier FRED flags, caches, GS exchange, monitor and event behavior remains in the shared owner.
implementation.choices: Successful compatibility transitions consume slots 0,1,2,3,5,6,7 for the high halves of RAX,RCX,RDX,RBX,RBP,RSI,RDI. Low halves and R8-R15 remain unchanged. These profile-owned choices neither invent native LowIR certificates nor an original after_operation index.
implementation.completion: Status 12 stops before the target or event delivery. Compatibility PC is an offset in the returned CS cache. A subsequent V9 invocation refuses compatibility entry.
implementation.compiler: Existing native LLVM/NeverC ERETU interfaces require no change for this explicit-state extension. No compiler API by itself certifies original machine-state continuation.

checks.name: Integrated continuation, original state, refinement and system-state checks

environment.tmp_quota: The integrated run binds task-local temporary storage over /tmp only in a private user/mount namespace because GoogleTest CapturedStream ignores TMPDIR on Linux. Host mounts and test expectations are unchanged.
environment.intentional_child_faults: The task-local PR_SET_DUMPABLE helper suppresses Apport handling of intentional test child faults. It is loaded after namespace creation.
environment.physical_fred: Host CPUID.7.1:EAX[17] is zero; no physical FRED execution is qualified.
